metadata.description: Azure region. Defaults to the resource group location.
Name of the Container App (and the prefix for its managed identity). Deploy one app per pool, e.g. sqlflow-worker-etl.
Resource id of an existing Container Apps managed environment to host the app.
Name of an existing Key Vault holding the catalog connection (and any flow) secrets.
Key Vault secret name for the catalog ADO.NET connection string.
The pool this deployment serves (single pool name, used for both SQLFLOW_WORKER_POOL and the scale query). Empty drains untargeted runs only.
Key Vault secret name for a token for private git remotes (SHA-pinned materialization). Leave empty when remotes are public.

Username paired with the git token when the host requires one (Bitbucket app passwords take the account username, repository access tokens take x-token-auth; GitHub ignores it). Empty sends the token alone.

Flow environment references, one object per ${env:...} reference the pool's flows use: { name: the environment variable, secretName: the Key Vault secret holding its value }. Credentials live on the node, never in the control plane.

Name of a container registry in THIS resource group: the template grants the app identity AcrPull on it and configures the pull. Leave empty for a public registry, or one you authorize yourself via acrLoginServer.
Login server of a registry outside this resource group (grant AcrPull to the app identity yourself). Ignored when acrName is set.

Key Vault secret name for a Go-driver-compatible catalog connection string used ONLY by the KEDA scale rule (a go-mssqldb URL, sqlserver://user:urlencoded-pw@host:port?database=...). The KEDA mssql scaler is not .NET SqlClient: it does not strip the single quotes an ADO.NET connection string puts around a password, so the .NET catalog connection cannot be reused for the scaler. Leave empty to reuse catalogConnectionSecretName for the scaler (correct only when that password needs no quoting).
Upper bound for queue-depth scale out.

How many runs one replica executes at once. MUST match the node's own concurrency (SqlFlow.Node RunWorker.DefaultMaxConcurrentRuns, 4), because the scale rule divides queued work by it to size the fleet. Setting it higher than the node's value starves the queue; lower spawns replicas that find nothing left to claim.
vCPU per replica, as a string for exact decimals. Must form a valid Container Apps consumption pair with memory.
Memory per replica, paired with cpu.

variables.gitTokenSecrets: [if(empty(parameters('gitTokenSecretName')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'git-token', 'keyVaultUrl', format('{0}secrets/{1}', variables('vaultUri'), parameters('gitTokenSecretName')), 'identity', resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-id', parameters('name'))))))]
variables.scalerSecrets: [if(empty(parameters('scalerConnectionSecretName')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'catalog-scaler', 'keyVaultUrl', format('{0}secrets/{1}', variables('vaultUri'), parameters('scalerConnectionSecretName')), 'identity', resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-id', parameters('name'))))))]
variables.queueDepthQuery: [if(empty(parameters('pool')), format('SELECT (SELECT MAX(v) FROM (VALUES ((CAST(CEILING((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [catalog].[Run] AS r WHERE r.[Status] = ''queued'' AND r.[TargetPool] IS NULL AND (r.[GroupId] IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [catalog].[Run] AS s WHERE s.[GroupId] = r.[GroupId] AND s.[GroupWave] < r.[GroupWave] AND s.[Status] IN (''queued'', ''running''))) AND (r.[GroupMaxConcurrency] IS NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [catalog].[Run] AS w WHERE w.[GroupId] = r.[GroupId] AND w.[Status] = ''running'') < r.[GroupMaxConcurrency]) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [catalog].[Run] AS p WHERE p.[PipelineId] = r.[PipelineId] AND p.[Status] = ''running'')) / {0}.0) AS int) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [catalog].[Node] WHERE [BusyRuns] > 0 AND [LastSeenUtc] >= DATEADD(second, -60, SYSUTCDATETIME()) AND ([Pool] = N'''' OR [Pool] IS NULL)))), (ISNULL((SELECT [MinReplicas] FROM [catalog].[WorkerPool] WHERE [Pool] = N''''), 0)), (ISNULL((SELECT CASE WHEN [ManualUntilUtc] > SYSUTCDATETIME() THEN [ManualReplicas] ELSE 0 END FROM [catalog].[WorkerPool] WHERE [Pool] = N''''), 0))) AS t(v))', parameters('maxConcurrentRunsPerReplica')), format('SELECT (SELECT MAX(v) FROM (VALUES ((CAST(CEILING((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [catalog].[Run] AS r WHERE r.[Status] = ''queued'' AND r.[TargetPool] = ''{0}'' AND (r.[GroupId] IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [catalog].[Run] AS s WHERE s.[GroupId] = r.[GroupId] AND s.[GroupWave] < r.[GroupWave] AND s.[Status] IN (''queued'', ''running''))) AND (r.[GroupMaxConcurrency] IS NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [catalog].[Run] AS w WHERE w.[GroupId] = r.[GroupId] AND w.[Status] = ''running'') < r.[GroupMaxConcurrency]) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [catalog].[Run] AS p WHERE p.[PipelineId] = r.[PipelineId] AND p.[Status] = ''running'')) / {1}.0) AS int) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [catalog].[Node] WHERE [BusyRuns] > 0 AND [LastSeenUtc] >= DATEADD(second, -60, SYSUTCDATETIME()) AND [Pool] = N''{2}''))), (ISNULL((SELECT [MinReplicas] FROM [catalog].[WorkerPool] WHERE [Pool] = N''{3}''), 0)), (ISNULL((SELECT CASE WHEN [ManualUntilUtc] > SYSUTCDATETIME() THEN [ManualReplicas] ELSE 0 END FROM [catalog].[WorkerPool] WHERE [Pool] = N''{4}''), 0))) AS t(v))', parameters('pool'), parameters('maxConcurrentRunsPerReplica'), parameters('pool'), parameters('pool'), parameters('pool')))]

resources.name: [parameters('name')]

configuration.registries: [if(empty(if(not(empty(parameters('acrName'))), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries', if(empty(parameters('acrName')), 'unused', parameters('acrName'))), '2023-07-01').loginServer, parameters('acrLoginServer'))), createArray(), createArray(createObject('server', if(not(empty(parameters('acrName'))), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries', if(empty(parameters('acrName')), 'unused', parameters('acrName'))), '2023-07-01').loginServer, parameters('acrLoginServer')), 'identity', resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-id', parameters('name'))))))]

containers.name: worker
containers.env: [concat(createArray(createObject('name', 'SQLFLOW_CATALOG_DB', 'secretRef', 'catalog-db'), createObject('name', 'SQLFLOW_WORKER_POOL', 'value', parameters('pool')), createObject('name', 'SQLFLOW_AZURE_AUTH', 'value', 'mi'), createObject('name', 'AZURE_CLIENT_ID', 'value', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-id', parameters('name'))), '2023-01-31').clientId)), variables('gitTokenEnv'), variables('gitUsernameEnv'), variables('flowEnvVars'))]

dependsOn: [extensionResourceId(resourceId('Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries', if(empty(parameters('acrName')), 'unused', parameters('acrName'))), 'Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments', guid(resourceGroup().id, parameters('acrName'), resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-id', parameters('name'))), variables('acrPullRoleId')))]

metadata.description: The client id of the worker identity (grant it access to the data its pool's flows touch).
The principal (object) id of the worker identity, for role assignments made outside this template.
